parameters.query:
INSERT INTO raw_events (
    external_id,
    payload,
    event_source,
    processing_status
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2::jsonb,
    $3,
    'processing'
)
ON CONFLICT (external_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
    event_source = EXCLUDED.event_source,
    processing_status = 'processing',
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING
    internal_id,
    external_id,
    payload,
    event_source,
    processing_status,
    retry_count;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message,
    workflow_name
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    'lead intake received',
    'success',
    $2,
    '01 - Lead Intake Router'
)
RETURNING internal_id;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.raw_events
SET last_execution_id = $2,
    last_workflow_name = $3,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = $1
RETURNING internal_id;

json.message: We want to automate lead routing and CRM follow-up creation. Right now inbound leads from paid campaigns are reviewed manually, enriched by the sales operations team, and assigned to account executives in spreadsheets before being updated in CRM. We need a workflow that deduplicates leads, scores them, assigns priority, creates follow-up tasks, and alerts the right team.
